Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game-art asset for a calm TV launcher scene, original cozy 16-bit pixel art. Reference image is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY; do not include any of its UI, logos, text, clock or app panel. Match its warm amber/orange deciduous trees, deep pine-green evergreens, slate-blue mountain ridges, blue lake, rich but readable pixel clusters, crisp square pixels. No antialiasing, blur, photo textures, outlines around a canvas rectangle, watermarks or text. We will render at a much smaller pixel resolution using nearest-neighbor scaling, so favor clear readable clusters over micro-detail. Each requested cutout is a single clean reusable sprite, not a sprite sheet.
Asset: full scene terrain/background layer, landscape aspect ratio approximately 10:7. A serene autumn mountain forest surrounding a broad lake, matching the approved pixel autumn concept. The upper 38 percent is EMPTY TRULY TRANSPARENT SKY, including above the ragged mountain skyline. Mountains rise from about 38 percent down; layered distant forest in blue and muted autumn shades fills the middle band. A long calm lake opens across the center and lower right, from about 63 percent down to 92 percent, with small rocky foreground banks at bottom left and bottom right. No close-up foreground trunks or overarching branches; those will be separate sprites. No clouds, sun, moon, stars, fog, Halloween decorations or moving foreground reeds. Keep all land and water opaque; only the open sky above the skyline is transparent. Pixel art cutout scene ready to composite over a separately colored sky.

It will be bent gently with a mesh so the base must have a clear root anchor.
